> Run Next.js and FastAPI as two long-lived processes and put PostgreSQL behind them as a managed database.

The cleanest default is to keep both on one server behind a reverse proxy so they share an origin, which skips CORS and keeps your secrets server-side. Split to separate origins only when you have a concrete reason, then add connection pooling, a background worker if you need one, SSL, and backups as the app grows.
